title: MIRAGE: Multimodal Immersive Reasoning and Guided Exploration for Red-Team Jailbreak Attacks
reasoning: The paper evaluates and benchmarks the success of jailbreak attacks against the safety and ethical safeguards of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). It utilizes datasets specifically designed to measure ethical violations, such as RedTeam-2K and HarmBench, which cover categories like unethical behavior, illegal activity, and harassment.
